query:
UPDATE virtual_teachers 
SET photo_url = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?w=400&h=500&fit=crop&crop=face',
    skin_tone = 'light'
WHERE name = 'Ingrid' AND (photo_url IS NULL OR photo_url = 'NULL');

UPDATE virtual_teachers 
SET voice_id = 'en-US-Wavenet-F',
    voice_language_code = 'en-US',
    voice_gender = 'FEMALE'
WHERE name = 'Teacher Ingrid' AND voice_id = 'en-US-JennyNeural';

UPDATE virtual_teachers 
SET voice_id = 'en-US-Wavenet-F',
    voice_language_code = 'en-US',
    voice_gender = 'FEMALE'
WHERE voice_id LIKE '%Neural%' OR voice_id LIKE '%Jenny%' OR voice_id LIKE '%Guy%';

SELECT id, name, photo_url, voice_id, voice_language_code FROM virtual_teachers WHERE name LIKE '%Ingrid%' OR name LIKE '%Ricardo%' OR name LIKE '%Kwame%' ORDER BY name;
